listDescription: Coordinators read this workspace's boards, tell you what needs you and why, and propose work you approve.
laterPhaseNote: What it watches, what it may do and its standing orders arrive in a later phase, as sections of each coordinator's page.
agentProfileMissingWarning: The agent profile was removed. Choose another.
agentProfilePassthroughWarning: The agent profile uses CLI passthrough, which a coordinator can't use. Choose another.
executorProfileMissingWarning: The executor was removed. Choose another.
passthroughDisabledReason: Uses CLI passthrough, which a coordinator can't use
contextRestartNote: Changing the context, agent profile or executor starts the next conversation fresh.
autoApproveIgnoredNote: The profile's auto-approve setting is ignored for coordinators.
deleteCoordinatorDescription: Delete {{name}}? This can't be undone. Pending proposals and the conversation are deleted; tasks it already created stay.
notFoundDescription: This coordinator no longer exists in this workspace.
nameRequiredReason: Enter a name of 1-60 characters to save.
